messages:
anna: Heads-up — planning a cutover for router + runtime + API changes during the Saturday change window: 2026-03-28 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need to pin console schema v12 and runtime kernel 1.4.2 together. @deploy-bot will run preflight checks an hour before.

deploy-bot: Preflight job created: preflight/2891234567. Steps: schema-compat, canary-deploy, perf-smoke. ETA start 01:00 UTC. Logs: https://ci/internal/preflight/2891234567

raj: Can we keep a traffic cushion? propose 20% cushion for first 30m then 40% rollback threshold.

mike: +1 on cushion. Also what's our rollback trigger? if 99th p50 latency > 200ms or error rate +0.5%? we need concrete numbers.

sydney: Suggest rollback if 95th latency regresses by >25% vs baseline or 5xx spike >0.3% sustained 5m. For traffic cushion: start at 10% canary -> 30% after 15m -> full at 45m.

eva: Don't forget release notes and console notices: add both runtime kernel caveats and pinned schema steps. I'll draft a short note and include rollback steps.

anna: Good call. For pin durations: pin console schema v12 for 3 days post-cutover to allow hotfixes. Runtime kernel pin for 24h then evaluate. Will tag on-call: @eng-oncall to monitor first hour.

raj: One more — router config change needs a fallback route. Can someone paste the snippet for the canary rule?

mike: Here:

```yaml
routing:
  canary:
    weight: 10
    match: header(x-canary) == 'true'
fallback:
  route: stable
```

mike: We'll have the console flag to flip x-canary for canary traffic.

deploy-bot: Preflight finished: all checks PASS except a flaky perf-run on p95. Marked for manual review. Action: @mike to re-run perf and @anna to confirm rollout cadence.

anna: I'll wait for the re-run. If perf rerun passes, proceed with 10% -> 30% -> 100% as sydney suggested with the traffic cushion and rollback rules above. If not, we hold and notify product. :thumbsup: 

eva: I'll prepare the release note draft and the post-deploy checklist (incident contacts, metric dashboards, runbooks).

sydney: tagging in ops: @eng-oncall please watch latency dashboards + tracer alerts at cutover.

raj: Sounds good. I'll add the pin entries to the deployment ticket and lock versions.

mike: Re-running perf now, will post results in thread.

mike: Perf rerun PASS (p95 within 8% of baseline). Cleared from my side.

anna: OK launching pre-cutover check at 01:00 UTC. I'll post final GO/NO-GO 30m before window. Thanks everyone.
